response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with a focus on open-source contributions and mentorship, but lacks the required depth in C++ and large-scale cloud compute leadership specified in the job description. His background in distributed systems and DevOps-adjacent work is promising, though his leadership experience appears more collaborative than directive.
strengths: Extensive experience with distributed systems and infrastructure (e.g., GISCollective, Optilyz, Dunnhumby media).
Proven mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions.
Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple languages and cloud technologies (AWS, Kubernetes).
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience (only ~1 year at National Instruments, far below the 8-year requirement).
Limited explicit technical leadership in cloud compute platforms (preferred qualification).
Most recent roles emphasize full-stack development over specialized cloud/infrastructure leadership.
